reviews.comment: Good choice for a level-400 math class if you're just in it for the grade. Exams are straightforward if you study the practice exams he post. The hw is not too bad either. His lectures can be difficult to digest since he covers a lot of content, but I felt like I learned a lot from them.

The class goes bullet fast and I got lost quite quickly as it covers so much content, but the exams are exactly the same as the practice exams. Just use AI to study the practice exams, and you'll do good on the actual exams. Did not attend lectures at all because I'm so far behind.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I can't keep up with his note-taking in class. He doesn't explain things well. He does post his lecture notes ahead of class, so I would read the textbook before class to get familiar with the topic first. The textbook is very well written and quick to read. Homework and tests aren't too difficult though.

If you need a math elective, this is the professor to take for this class. He does not make content overly complicated. He is very concise, and his notes are very good. His exams are not hard, just like the practice test, and TAs help with homework. Final was take-home -- follow his notes and you will do well. He also grades very forgivingly.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you need a 400 level math credit, take 417 with Yalchin. Tests are the exact same as the practice exams but with different numbers. Homework at most once a week. I almost never went to class, just study the practice exam, know how to solve each question and take the tests. Final is also take home.
It's difficult to find any 400 level math class that's manageable, but 417 with Efendiev definitely was. Take 417 with him if at all possible. Was very graceful with late work and grading
Very good professor! He explains the concepts well and wants each of them to do well! He's willing to help on anything and grades fairly! 10/10!

The notes of this professor are concise, which show the key points you need to know. Homework may be challenging but helpful to understand the methods of numerical analysis and to increase the ability of coding. Efficient teaching, nice professor, take him.
Good professor, knowledgeable about what he's teaching. Lectures can be a bit confusing but lots of examples, homework, and study guide are good preparation for tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Efendiev was a great teacher for 308. I took him honors and found it very easy to do well in the class. The lectures are not always clear, but I found the material easy to pick up outside of class and in office hours. The tests are very simple and he gives practice exams that prepare you for almost the exact test.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Grades super easy on exams. Exams are just like the practice exams he gives about a week in advance before the tests as well. Homework over all the sections, but he gives plenty of time to complete it. His lectures can be pretty poor since he doesn't explain himself really well, but with some tutoring and extra studying you will do fine.
